Savremene vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i upotreba virtuelne stvarnosti, pružaju jedinstven i dinamičan doživljaj praćenja informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Mrtav 'ladan
programme.desc: Kiza i Lemi su dva brata, koja, nakon što ostanu bez novca, odluče da svog mrtvog dedu prošvercuju vozom do Vršca, gde će ga sahraniti. Oblače ga u odelu, i stavljaju u voz, govoreći svima kako spava. Ali, u vozu se zatekao i diler droge, koji u stahu od policije, paketić podvaljuje dedi u džep. Dok su Lemi i Kiza u vagon restoranu, voz naglo koči, a na dedu pada kofer. Misleći da ga je to ubilo, ostali putnici izbacuju telo kroz prozor, a braći govore da je jednostavno otišao da prošeta. Oni kreću u potragu za mrtvim dedom.

programme.title: SportUna
programme.desc: Sportuna donosi savremen i dinamičan format koji spaja stručnu analizu, ekskluzivna gostovanja i zabavan ugao posmatranja sporta. U centru pažnje su najvažnija dešavanja iz Evrolige, sa posebnim fokusom na učinak KK Crvena zvezda i KK Partizan, ali i velika međunarodna sportska takmičenja, uključujući i predstojeće Svetsko prvenstvo u fudbalu. Voditeljski tandem Milan Bošković i Milutin Aleksić vode gledaoce kroz pregled najvažnijih sportskih aktuelnosti tokom nedelje – od analize ključnih utakmica i razgovora sa relevantnim imenima iz sveta sporta, do uključenja igrača koji nastupaju u inostranstvu. Poseban kvalitet emisije ogleda se u pažljivo građenom balansu između ozbiljne, argumentovane analize i opuštenijeg tona koji sport približava širokoj publici. Pored stručnih komentara voditelja, u studiju gostuju i javne ličnosti koje sport doživljavaju pre svega kao strast i navijačko iskustvo, donoseći lični pogled, emociju i autentičnost koja emisiju čini bliskom i prepoznatljivom širokom krugu gledalaca.

programme.title: Mućke
programme.desc: Legendarnu britansku seriju Mućke (eng. Only Fools and Horses) gledaoci Una televizije gledaju ponovo s velikom pažnjom i radošću jer dogodovštine porodice Troter su jednostavno vanvremenske. Ovo je priča o nesvakidašnjim avanturama braće Delboja i Rodnija, koje su tumačili sjajni glumci Ser Dejvid Džejson (David Jason) i Nikolas Lindherst (Nicholas Lyndhurst). Serija je prvi put emitovana 1981. godine na BBC-ju i trajala je sve do 2003. godine, obuhvatajući sedam sezona i 64 epizode, uključujući božićne specijale. U svojoj autobiografiji My Life, Dejvid Džejson je podelio anegdotu o lažnoj svađi sa Lindherstom tokom snimanja. Zbog dosade na setu, odlučili su da insceniraju žestoku raspravu, bacajući predmete i vičući jedan na drugog, što je prestravilo članove ekipe koji su pokušali da ih smire. Jednog dana Nik i ja smo bili u našoj maloj prikolici na setu. Bilo nam je dosadno, jer se ništa nije dešavalo, pa smo se dogovorili: 'Zašto ne bismo inscenirali veliku svađu i ti izjuriš, kažeš da sve napuštaš, a ja mogu da vičem za tobom da ne treba nikad više da se vratiš', izjavio je Džejson. Kasnije su priznali da je sve bila šala, ali je ova priča doprinela glasinama o njihovom navodnom sukobu. Uprkos glasinama o navodnoj svađi, Džejson i Nikolas su uvek isticali međusobno poštovanje i prijateljstvo. Džejson je izjavio: Niste mogli imati boljeg partnera od Nika. Voleli smo se i poštovali toliko mnogo; bili smo istinski dobri prijatelji. Nakon završetka serije, Lindherst je nastavio da glumi u raznim

programme.title: Jedno pitanje
programme.desc: Ovaj jedinstveni kviz nije samo test znanja već nesvakidašnja kombinacija znanja, igre i super zabave. Za osvajanje novčane nagrade od čak 500.000,00 dinara takmičarima su potrebni intuicija, malo sreće i nezaobilazna podrška šarmantne voditeljke Marije Kilibarde. Pravila su jednostavna: svaki takmičarski par dobija jedno pitanje i 16 ponuđenih odgovora. Kroz sistem eliminacije, pokušavaju da pronađu jedini tačan odgovor, i uz pažljivo razmišljanje i mrvu odvažnosti, nagrada može biti njihova.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: To je život
programme.desc: Od 14. marta, svakog četvrtka, premijerno na UNA televiziji gledaćete emisiju To je život - jedinstveni autorski projekat više puta nagrađivane talentovane novinarke Jasne Đurović: Emisija To je život je ostvarenje mog sna, onog najvećeg koji sam imala još onog dana kad sam odlučila da studiram novinarstvo. Znala sam da nikada ne želim da se bavim ovim poslom na današnji, uobičajen, način - da samo nešto zabeležim i prenesem. Meni je novinarstvo prilika da utičem, promenim i na prvom mestu pomognem i čoveku i društvu u celini. Ono što će gledaoci moći da vide u mojim emisijima u kojima se pojavljujem i kao voditelj i kao novinar - zaista će biti najveće životne priče. One koje i bukvalno liče na filmski scenario, a u stavri ne mogu biti istinitije. To je ono što samo život može da priredi i odredi i što se samo životom objašnjava. Zato se emisija i zove kako se zove i beleži zaista one nejneverovatnije stvari. Neverovatna Jasna ne krije i da veliku zahvalnost duguje svojoj medijskoj kući: Dugujem ogromnu, ali ogromnu zahvalnost, UNA televiziji koja mi je ukazala tu čast i privilegiju da tačno na osamnaestogodišnjicu televizijske karijere dobijem autorsku emisiju i da to bude baš ono što je na neki način i obeležilo moj dosadašnji rad. Ono što zaista mislim da najbolje umem i što osećam - ne samo kao posao, već i kao suštinu svog bića.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Čarlijevi anđeli: Totalno zagušenje
programme.desc: Tri agentkinje su u potrazi za parom posebnih titanskih prstena koji zajedno daju niz šifrovanih informacija. Dok traže ove dragocene predmete, Natali, Dilan i Aleks se suočavaju sa pretnjama koje dolaze od njihovih starih, ali i novih neprijatelja...

programme.title: Lovac na čudovišta
programme.desc: Nakon što su pogođeni strašnom peščanom olujom, kapetanica Artemis i njen tim stižu na nepoznatu teritoriju, gde vladaju ogromna čudovišta koja imaju izražen ubilački instinkt. Dok pokušavaju da im se suprotstave, sreću Lovca, misterioznog čoveka koji jedini uspeva da porazi ova strašna bića.

programme.title: Terminator: Mračna sudbina
programme.desc: Deni Ramos je sasvim obična devojka koja sa bratom Dijegom radi u fabrici automobila. Istog dana kada dobije otkaz na poslu, Deni saznaje da će imati važnu ulogu u budućnosti čovečanstva i da opake mašine zbog toga žele da je ubiju. Zbog toga se udružuje sa Grejs, iskusnom ratnicom iz budućnosti i Sarom Konor, ženom koja je pre 25 godina sprečila kraj sveta. U zajedničkom frontu protiv smrtonosnog Terminatora, uskoro im se pridružuje i čuveni model T-800.

Prema majanskom kalendaru 21.12.2012. dogodiće se smak sveta. Kada globalna kataklizma pretvori svet u haos, razvedeni pisac Džekson Kurtis (Džon Kjuzak) iskoristiće saznanja iz starih proročanstava da spreči potpuno istrebljenje ljudske vrste.

programme.title: Derviš i smrt
programme.desc: Ahmet Nurudin, derviš i starešina islamskog manastira u Sarajevu je personifikacija morala i dogmatskog verovanja, svega na čemu počiva muslimanska vera. Kroz njegov život, atmosferu grada i odnosa sa sudijom, otkriva se slika Osmanskog carstva na početku devetnaestog veka.

programme.title: Očima deteta
programme.desc: Emisija Očima deteta donosi zabavne igre, edukativne segmente i dečje perspektive na bitne i svakodnevne teme. Naše male zvezde istražuju svet kroz igru postavljajući pitanja na važne (i manje važne) životne dileme, dok su poznate ličnosti i stručnjaci iz različitih oblasti specijalni gosti u studiju Una televizije i pokušavaju i sami da se snađu dečjoj stolici.

programme.title: Best egzotik merigold hotel
programme.desc: Grupa penzionera iz Britanije odlučuje da napravi veliki preokret u svom životu tako što će se preseliti u jedan hotel u Indiji. Stvari se ne odvijaju kako su planirali, ali im nove okolnosti pomažu da promene svoj pogled na svet.

programme.title: Planina koja nas razdvaja
programme.desc: Ben i Aleks su potpuni stranci koji su odlučili da iznajme privatni avion nakon što im je let otkazan u poslednji čas. Tokom leta, pilot doživljava moždani udar i umire, a dvoje ljudi koji se do pre nekoliko sati nisu ni poznavali sada moraju da učine sve kako bi preživeli i našli način da se vrate kući.

programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: Štafeta
programme.desc: Štafeta je emisija Una televizije koja povezuje glasove ljudi iz svih država bivše Jugoslavije, otvarajući prostor za dijalog, razmenu mišljenja i suočavanje različitih pogleda na teme koje nas jednako dotiču. U vremenu kada nas svakodnevica često deli granicama, politikom i različitim interpretacijama prošlosti, Štafeta podseća da region i dalje deli iste emocije, dileme i iskustva. Svaka epizoda donosi jednu centralnu temu – od kulture, muzike i medija do identiteta, društvenih pitanja i života običnih ljudi. Kroz razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima iz Srbije, Hrvatske, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Severne Makedonije i Slovenije, emisija gradi prostor u kojem svako ima pravo na svoj glas. Štafeta ne traži nužno zajednički odgovor, već iskren razgovor i pokušaj da se region ponovo čuje – bez buke, predrasuda i granica.

programme.title: Imanje za spašavanje
programme.desc: Raneyjevi i dalje spašavaju dom načinjen od bala gume u Ohiju. Vremena je sve manje, a oni rade na opskrbi vodom, jačaju zidove i pokreću zatvoreni vrt.

programme.title: Psi: Neispričana priča
programme.desc: Uputite se na put oko svijeta i otkrijte kako su psi postali najdragocjenije životinje na planetu. Od grabežljivaca do ljubimaca - ovo je priča o čovjekovom najboljem prijatelju.

programme.title: Životinjski domovi
programme.desc: Antonio dvorište opasno po zdravlje pretvara u odmaralište za pse. Tim postavlja hranilicu i fontanu za piće koju psi mogu uključiti šapom.

programme.title: Teksaški zakon
programme.desc: Lovočuvari crvenom risu nalaze novi dom te istražuju slučaj nezakonito ubijenog jelena. Usto, lovočuvari Ben i Chelsea provjeravaju komercijalne brodove za kamenice.

programme.title: Ljudi iz aljaške divljine
programme.desc: Duboko u aljaškom bušu živi obitelj rođena i odgojena u divljini. Billy i Amy Brown sa svojih sedmero djece žive u potpunoj izolaciji i ovise jedni o drugima da bi preživjeli. PREMIERE

programme.title: Ljudi iz aljaške divljine
programme.desc: Duboko u aljaškom bušu živi obitelj rođena i odgojena u divljini. Billy i Amy Brown i njihovo sedmero djece žive sasvim izolirano i oslanjaju se jedni na druge da bi preživjeli.

programme.title: Dodo junaci
programme.desc: Prikazujemo vam nadahnjujuće priče o životinjama iz cijelog svijeta kojima je prijeko potrebna pomoć te o hrabrim muškarcima i ženama koji čine nezamislive stvari da bi im pomogli.

programme.title: Pandamonij
programme.desc: Pratite veliku pandu Mao Mao i njezin tim u borbi za očuvanje vrste u jednom od najuspješnijih centara za razmnožavanje panda na svijetu. Od trudnoće do odrastanja mladunčadi, zabilježeni su izazovi,...

programme.title: Divlja ljepota Meksika
programme.desc: Meksiko je stara i veličanstvena zemlja puna raznolikosti i tajni. Dom prostrane divljine oceana i džungli te jedinstvenih stvorenja koja se ne mogu naći nigdje drugdje na Zemlji.

programme.title: Novine: Izumi koji mijenjaju svijet
programme.desc: "Pratite najbolje znanstvenike, inženjere, poduzetnike i izumitelje dok pokušavaju revolucionirati njihova izabrana područja i doći do prijelomnih otkrića."

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Veterinarska bolnica "Rocky Mountain"
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff liječi psa nakon što je na autocesti iskočio iz auta koji se kretao velikom brzinom, a par spašenih zamoraca izaziva pomutnju u uredu.

programme.title: Kraljevi akvarija
programme.desc: Poznati sportaš i šampion Super Bowla Marshawn Lynch angažirao je Bretta i Waydea da mu izgrade vrhunski nabrijan Beastmode akvarij.

programme.title: Policajci za životinje: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Djelatnici pensilvanijskog SPCA-a odgovaraju na poziv koji se tiče napuštenih životinja. No ništa ih ne može pripremiti na ono što će otkriti u hladnjaku u kuhinji.

programme.title: Policajci za životinje: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Kada filadelfijska policija razotkrije cijelu operaciju koja se bavi borbama pasa, pensilvanijski SPCA istražuje cijeli slučaj, što dovodi do užasne ekshumacije u dvorištu.

programme.title: Nerazboriti ljubimci
programme.desc: U ovoj dokumentarnoj seriji pratimo priče ekscentričnih pojedinaca koji su razvili posebnu vezu s neobičnim i egzotičnim životinjama, od divovskih aligatora i polarnih medvjeda do otrovnih škorpiona i...

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Trattoria
programme.desc: This funny and heartwarming dramedy set in the exciting San Francisco culinary scene follows Sal Sartini, a workaholic chef who must learn to rekindle his passion for cooking and love, and repair the bond he has with his son before he risks losing everything again.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: The Devil's Throat
programme.desc: Reflecting on friendship, love, and betrayal, the story follows the criminal investigation into a horrific murder of a victim involved in a refugee channel. With bizarre evidence accumulating, will the detectives be able to solve the case?

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Action, starring Michael Douglas and Kiefer Sutherland. A veteran presidential protector finds himself the lead suspect in an assassination plot.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Action, starring Michael Douglas and Kiefer Sutherland. A veteran presidential protector finds himself the lead suspect in an assassination plot.

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor
The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Little Crumb: Race To the Gold Mine
programme.desc: Little Crumb is finally reunited with his parents, and now he is no longer a street urchin. He enjoys a splendid villa with his Mom and Dad. His days are peaceful and calm, and boring, as he does not have the excitement and adventures he is used to while living in a big city. He decides to run away and take his dog with him. Anna tries to stop him, but they are both kidnapped by the old enemy of the family. Now he has to use tall the skills and lifehacks of his new and his old life to escape and save his family.

programme.title: Redemption of the Ghost
programme.desc: Convicted embezzler Witt Hampton escapes from prison and while hiding out in an isolated country barn is discovered by young Cassy and her brother Jack. After convincing them he's a friendly ghost that only they can see, the three new friends embark on one imaginative adventure after another until, inspired by their innocent spirits, Witt vows to redeem his crimes. But, a by-the-book sheriff-who has sworn to personally put Hampton back behind bars-is closing in, and Witt may never get the chance to finally set things right.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef Carl Casper runs the kitchen of a thriving Los Angeles restaurant. Before the arrival of a leading restaurant critic, Carl wants to experiment with a new menu, but the commercial restaurant owner will not allow that. The result is a devastating review.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: An updated version of the 1980 musical, which centered on the students of the New York Academy of Performing Arts.

programme.title: This Boy's Life
programme.desc: Drama, based on the memoirs of Tobias Wolff, starring Robert De Niro and Leonardo DiCaprio. In the 1950s, teenager Toby and his single mum move to Washington, where she meets the mild-mannered Dwight. The pair eventually marry and at first, everything is harmonious. But Toby soon discovers his new stepfather believes violence is the best way to deal with a rebellious youngster. Ellen Barkin and Jonah Blechman also star.

programme.title: This Boy's Life
programme.desc: Drama, based on the memoirs of Tobias Wolff, starring Robert De Niro and Leonardo DiCaprio. In the 1950s, teenager Toby and his single mum move to Washington, where she meets the mild-mannered Dwight. The pair eventually marry and at first, everything is harmonious. But Toby soon discovers his new stepfather believes violence is the best way to deal with a rebellious youngster. Ellen Barkin and Jonah Blechman also star.

programme.title: Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: First Dog
programme.desc: A foster boy is befriended by a lost dog who turns out to belong to the President of the United States. The boy decides to run away from the foster home to return the canine to the White House -- "Because it's the right thing to do!"

programme.title: Death Defying Acts
programme.desc: On a tour of Britain in 1926, Harry Houdini enters into a passionate affair with a psychic out to con the famous magician.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: Niko nije anđeo
programme.desc: Trudnica koja beži od momka nasilnika, ukrcava se u voz, a štiti je upravo venčan bračni par. Kada se voz slupa, mladenci ginu, a identitet trudne devojke zamenjen je s pokojnom mladom, jer je u trenutku sudara nosila njenu burmu.

programme.title: Smrtna kazna
programme.desc: Nik Hjum je povučen čovek, izvršni direktor sa savršenim životom, koji jedne večeri postaje svedok događaja koji ga zauvek menja. Ophrvan tugom, Hjum dolazi do uznemirujućeg zaključka da ne postoji granica koju neće preći kako bi zaštitio svoju porodicu.

programme.title: Zavejani
programme.desc: Dvoje novopečenih prijatelja pokušavaju da pobegnu ostavljenom ljubavniku, koji traži svoj novac i još ponešto.

programme.title: Njuškalo i lov na letećeg fantoma
programme.desc: Rat je završen i selom je zavladao mir. Ali onda, iznenada, tajanstvena prilika u crnom počinje da vreba seljane. Legenda kaže da se ponovo vratio Leteći fantom. Tom, njegova devojka Mirjam i Njuškalo kreću u istragu. Zahvaljujući Njuškalovim posebnim sposobnostima, fantom je uhvaćen u zamku, a zlokobna zavera ubistva i osvete otkrivena je baš na vreme!

programme.title: Njuškalo i ukleti dvorac
programme.desc: Njuškala, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture. Tokom letnjeg raspusta Tom ostaje s Mirjam i Njuškalom kod svog čika Hansa i bratanca Jaapa. Čuli su za ukleti dvorac u susedstvu. Legenda o ovom dvorcu kaže da se u srednjem veku izvesni vitez Betram zaljubio u sluškinju Ejdu, ali je ona već bila zaljubljena u konjušara. Betram rešava da se na užasan način osveti ovo dvoje i od tada se priča da je šuma oko dvorca ukleta. Na putu kroz šumu do dvorca, Tom, Mirjam i Njuškalo prate bandu krijumčara. To ih ponovo vodi u uzbudljivu avanturu…

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Skoro prijatelji
programme.desc: Čarli, neambiciozni muškarac u srednjim dvadesetim godinama koji i dalje živi s majkom i očuhom i zaljubljuje se u mladu ženu koja je u vezi s ozbiljnim muškarcem.

programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše.

programme.title: Bez očiglednog motiva
programme.desc: Čineći uslugu prijatelju i tražeći odbeglu tinejdžerku, policijski detektiv nailazi na bizarnu grupu kriminalaca koji se spremaju za veliku pljačku banke.

programme.title: Dobri komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Slepa opsednutost
programme.desc: U pucnjavi u kojoj su učestvovala dvojica braće iz kriminalnog miljea, policajac Džek Flečer gubi vid. Tokom oporavka pomaže mu Rebeka, trener za nedavno oslepele. Postepeno, Džek i Rebeka se zaljubljuju uprkos protivljenju Rebekine sestre Bedelije, koja je u detinjstvu, kao žrtva incesta, razvila patološku mržnju prema muškarcima. Kada mu se vid vrati, Džek shvata da je meta dvoje potencijalnih ubica: lude sestre Bedelije ili brata kriminalca kojeg je ubio.

programme.title: Noćna tabla

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se da održi svoju poslastičarnicu, ali jednog dana izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora primorava je da zatvori posao. Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Njuškalo i ledena ptica
programme.desc: Njuškalo, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture.U ovoj avanturi, Tom i njegovi prijatelji Njuškalo i Mirjam idu na jedrenje tokom letnjeg raspusta. Usput na vašaru sreću strašnu braću Džimija i Nilsa, kao i njihovog psa Lebasa. Tako počinje još jedna šerlokholmsovska avantura…

programme.title: Njuškalo u ratu
programme.desc: Nakon što su mu roditelji poginuli u bombardovanju tokom Drugog svetskog rata, Tomas u poslali da živi s rođacima na seoskoj farmi u Holandiji. On je tužan, ljut i uplašen i prezire što mora da živi sa tetkom i tečom.Ali kad Tom dobije da gaju nemačkog ovčara Njuškala, sve se iz korena menja. On sve svoje poverenje poklanja Njuškalu i zajedno se trude da izvuku najbolje od života iako je njihovo selo pod nemačkom kontrolom.Uz Njuškalovu pomoć Tom spasava holandskog pilota koji je oboren i ranjen. Ali kada holandski nacistički kolaboracionista pošalje vojnike da traže pilota, na Njuškalu i Tomu je da razotkriju izdajnika. Pilot uspeva da pobegne u svoju jedinicu, a Njuškalo nazad dovodi vojsku kako bi oslobodili grad."Njuškalo u ratu" je dostupno u dve verzije, kao dugometražni igrani film ili kao mini-serija od četiri polučasovne epizode.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Šta sve činimo zbog ljubavi
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: Tomiris, kraljica Amazonki, povela je 600 godina pre nove ere krvavi rat protiv Persijskog carstva. Kada persijski kralj Kir uništi njeno selo, ona okuplja ogromnu vojsku da oslobodi svoj narod. Slede spektakularne bitke, borbe na život i smrt i spletke surovog kralja koji silom i prevarama želi da pokori narod.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Film je u celosti smešten u večeri u kojoj se odvija premijerno izvođenje srednjoškolske postavke Šekspirovog "Sna letnje noći". Film "Premijera" je hronika katastrofalnih dešavanja na sceni, kao i drame koju iza scene preživljavaju neki od učenika, njihov profesor književnosti i gostujuća zvezda B produkcije.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Pustinjski plen
programme.desc: Mlada botaničarka dolazi u mali pustinjski grad kako bi proučavala invazivnu biljnu vrstu. Nakon pada aviona, zarobljava je neiskusni kurir droge i primorava da ga vodi kroz surovu pustinju. Dok šerif traga za njima, njegova buntovna ćerka kreće u potragu za nestalom naučnicom.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Han Dong-su priprema odbranu svoje supruge Hje-jong, ali situacija dobija neočekivan obrt kada So Do-jong ponudi pomoć.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Han Dong-su priprema odbranu svoje supruge Hje-jong, ali situacija dobija neočekivan obrt kada So Do-jong ponudi pomoć.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Hje-jong dobija spor. U zamenu za pomoć So Do-jonga, Han Dong-su predlaže novu poslovnu ideju. Granica između dobra i zla sve je tanja.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon uspeha na sudu, Dong-su dobija primamljivu ponudu da pokrene internet kazino u zamenu za otpis dugova svoje porodice.

programme.title: Živeti u strahu
programme.desc: Muž i žena vraćaju se u njegov rodni grad, na otvaranje očevog testamenta. Ubrzo im postaje jasno da je grad krcat Čakovim davnašnjim neprijateljima. Mnogi od njih smatraju da ih je njegov otac (sveštenik) prevario za investicije vredne 250 hiljada dolara.

programme.title: Sumnja
programme.desc: Darel Džejkobs je penzionisani mafijaš koji živi u Finiksu. Kada oboli od raka, shvata da mu vreme ističe, pa svakodnevno posećuje svoj omiljeni kafić. Mlada konobarica Ališa Foret, studentkinja prava, zaintrigirana je tajanstvenim redovnim gostom, pa ga prati do kuće. Ubrzo započinje prijateljstvo koje Ališu dovodi u opasnost i primorava Darela da dovrši "nesvršena posla". Ališin momak Tom ne odobrava njihovo prijateljstvo, pa ih prati. Kada otkrije Darelov pravi identitet, Tom upada u paniku, ali ne zbog bezbednosti svoje devojke, već zbog sopstvene.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre " Kralj ratnika"

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Paigeina majka želi da kći krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, no Paige želi biti spisateljica. Kada Joan odluči prodati izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Paige to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži posljednju šansu — ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da nitko, pa ni Daniel, posljednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena obitelj predstavlja prijetnju.

programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Kad njena sestra nestane, Džil je ubeđena da se vratio serijski ubica koji ju je kidnapovao pre dve godine. Spremna je da se još jednom suoči s čovekom koji ju je oteo.

programme.title: Božićni izazov
programme.desc: Voditeljka podkasta Lora Ros i njen dugogodišnji prijatelj i producent Pol, suočeni su sa preispitivanjem svog ličnog i profesionalnog odnosa. Sve počinje kada slušalac njihovog ambicioznog podkasta "Moderni i nezavisni" predloži dnevne "Božićne izazove" koji promovišu zajedništvo.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom
programme.desc: Tokom krstarenja Karibima, Dženi ostaje nasukana na obali sa svojim rokenrol idolom. Očarana idejom da će neko vreme provesti nasamo s njim, uspeva da sakrije činjenicu da se nalaze na samo nekoliko koraka od svog odmarališta.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi klik
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Maćeha iz pakla
programme.desc: Izi počinje da sumnja da njena nova maćeha i polusestra žele da se dokopaju bogatstva njenog oca, čije se zdravlje naglo pogoršava. Njen život se pretvara u košmar kada otkrije proneveru i korupciju u porodičnoj firmi, zbog čega je neko, u želji da nedelo prikrije, spreman i da ubije.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Uverena da joj je muž možda živ, Se-jon posumnja u dadilju Jung-sim. Eun-su, uz Sun-hoovu karticu, prati očevu ljubavnicu, dok Hva-jong uznemirava žena bliska Te-ou. Da li je istina u koju su verovale zapravo bila laž?

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Se-jon pronalazi Sang-hunov dnevnik i počinje da sumnja u njegov identitet. Jung-von parališe snimak afere s Min-gjuom. Istražujući Min-džejevu smrt, Eun-su nailazi na tragove drugih žena. Hva-jong tokom tajnog susreta s Te-oom saznaje razornu istinu.

programme.title: The Fatal Hour
programme.desc: When a police officer is murdered, Captain Street looks to Mr. Wong to catch the killer. Prime Suspect: Frank Belden Jr., whose father is a businessman well known for both his success and dishonesty. Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.title: In Old Mexico
programme.desc: Escaped criminal "The Fox" hates Hoppy and a Rurales colonel for imprisoning him and lures Cassidy to Mexico in order to exact his vengeance.

programme.title: The Painted Desert
programme.desc: Western pardners Jeff and Cash find a baby boy in an otherwise deserted emigrants' camp, and clash over which is to be "father." They are still bitterly feuding years later when they own adjacent ranches. Bill, the foundling whom Cash has raised to young manhood, wants to end the feud and extends an olive branch toward Jeff, who now has a lovely daughter. But during a mining venture, the bitterness escalates. Is Bill to be set against his own adoptive father?

programme.title: Sleepless
programme.desc: Count Karl Ulysses von Salis-Marschlins was a Swiss botanist and naturalist. He travelled widely observing and studying the lands he visited. In 1789 he travelled in the Kingdom of Naples. On returning home, he wrote a book about it. Here is how he described his visit to the "Casino del Duca" at San Basilio, the largest estate of Apulia, South Italy. "Anapeson" are these places, now, sleepless and abandoned within the distracted modernity. The History as ruins.

programme.title: The Frontiersmen
programme.desc: The local school is causing Hoppy problems. First Bar 20 cattle are stolen when Hoppy investigates a problem there. Then the new teacher arrives and disrupts the routine of the Bar 20 hands. Later with the Bar 20 hands at graduation, the rustlers are poised to strike again. But there is dissension among them and this will lead to the break that Hoppy needs.

programme.title: Wake Me When the War Is Over
programme.desc: During the final months of WW2, a lonely German Baroness hides an attractive American airman in her mansion for long time without telling him the war has been over for almost five years.

programme.title: Schengen
programme.desc: In one Paris divided militarily into two like was the former Berlin Est-Ouest, Ines Raymond receives from the right bank people who ask for a visa for the left bank. Each have their reasons and dreams for crossing the Seine, but, Ines must follow the new instructions.

programme.title: My Favourite Brunette
programme.desc: Ronnie Jackson is a lowly baby photographer who secretly fantasizes about being a private detective. When a lovely baroness actually mistakes him for one and asks him to help locate her missing husband, Baron Montay, Ronnie finds himself agreeing. Several days later he is on death row whiling away the hours until his execution by recounting to a group of reporters the bizarre tale of how he ended up there.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: My Dear Secretary
programme.desc: A budding young writer thinks it's her lucky day when she is chosen to be the new secretary for Owen Waterbury, famous novelist. She is soon disppointed, however, when he turns out to be an erratic, immature playboy. Opposites attract, of course, but not without sub-plots that touch on competitiveness within marriage and responsibility.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: The Plague at the Karatas Village
programme.desc: A new mayor comes to the remote village Karatas. A very strange illness reins over here. However somebody is used to live with it and says this is a simple flu.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Christmas Wish
programme.desc: A little squirrel with lots of charm accidentally helps two poor, down-but-NOT-out families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Bluebeard
programme.desc: Young female models are being strangled. Will law enforcement be able to stop the crime wave before more women become victims?

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous
programme.desc: Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before performing at her school, a visiting Broadway producer encourages her by telling her positive things about her sister. Soon afterwards, Sherry decides to make a surprise trip to New York to visit Josephine _ but what she finds there is not at all what she expected.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

programme.title: Tokyo Twilight
programme.desc: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

programme.title: One Body Too Many
programme.desc: An insurance salesman arrives at a creepy mansion to discover his potential eccentric millionaire client already dead. Instead he gets embroiled in a house full of greedy, murderous relatives competing for the inheritance.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: Inertial Love
programme.desc: The relationship between Javier and Anna runs out of gas. She hits the brakes and Javier is dragged by inertia until he learns to get over it.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: My Man Godfrey
programme.desc: Fifth Avenue socialite Irene Bullock needs a "forgotten man" to win a scavenger hunt, and no one is more forgotten than Godfrey Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. Irene hires Godfrey as a servant for her riotously unhinged family, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister, Cornelia, who tries her best to get Godfrey fired. As Irene falls for her new butler, Godfrey turns the tables and teaches the frivolous Bullocks a lesson or two.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Operation Bottleneck
programme.desc: WW II Burma...Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese. It will ultimately cost them their lives, except for one "lucky" survivor.

programme.title: Speak Easily
programme.desc: A timid professor inherits a large sum of money and decides to fund a terrible musical.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: Sam Tucker, a cotton picker, in search of a better future for his family, decides to grow his own cotton crop. In the first year, the Tuckers battle disease, a flood, and a jealous neighbor. Can they make it as farmers?

programme.title: Stingaree
programme.desc: A young lady named Hilda who works as a servant for the wealthy Clarksons, sheep farmers, and dreams of being a great singer. An upcoming visit by Sir Julian, a famous composer arriving from London, drives jealous Mrs. Clarkson (an interfering biddy who fancies she can sing _ but can't) to send away Hilda, so he doesn't hear Hilda has a good voice. Meanwhile, an infamous outlaw named Stingaree has just arrived in town and kidnaps Sir Julian, then poses as him at the Clarksons, where he meets Hilda a few hours before she is to leave.

programme.title: A Shriek in the Night
programme.desc: Rival newspaper reporters Pat Morgan and Ted Rand find themselves unraveling the mystery behind the death of a millionaire philanthropist who fell from his penthouse balcony. When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: Quality Time
programme.desc: Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: Ginza Cosmetics
programme.desc: A luckless geisha struggles to make a living for herself and her young son.

programme.title: The Waiting
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat
programme.desc: Lise, a mentally unbalanced middle-aged woman, travels from her home in Copenhagen to Rome, Italy where she embarks on a fatal destiny, a premeditated search for someone, anyone, with whom she can form a dangerous liaison.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: When did you last talk with your father? Will you ever ask him about those things that hurt you? In Father the reality of life is turned upside down to create an impossible dialogue _ the dialogue between a child and a father that never happens.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Marshall Dan Mitchell, who is the law in Abilene, has the job of keeping peace between two groups. For a long time, the town had been divided, with the cattlemen and cowboys having one end of town to themselves, while townspeople occupied the other end. Mitchell liked it this way, it made things easier for him, and kept problems from arising between the two factions.

programme.title: Bela Lugosi Meets a Brooklyn Gorilla
programme.desc: Two goofy entertainers meet a mad scientist on a jungle island.

programme.title: The Jungle Woman
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: Port of New York
programme.desc: Two narcotics agents go after a gang of murderous drug dealers who use ships docking at the New York harbor to smuggle in their contraband.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Gung Ho!
programme.desc: The true story of Carlson's Raiders and their World War II attack on Makin Island.

programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Songwriter and Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern is unable to find immediate success in the U.S. He sought recognition abroad. He journeyed to England where his dreams of success became real and where he met his future wife Eva Leale.

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: The Lady of Musashino
programme.desc: Set in post-war Japan, The Lady of Musashino tells the story of Michiko, a disillusioned young woman trapped in a loveless marriage. She confides in her younger cousin, Tsutomo, and the two become close, but decide not to consummate their affair. He instead becomes involved with the flirtatious Tomiko, who is also conducting an affair with Michiko's husband. When Michiko finds that her husband has abandoned her, she decides to take her fate into her own hands.

programme.title: Casimira
programme.desc: In a small house, in the middle of the imposing Patagonia, lives Casimira (80), an old woman with a kind look who spends her days in the middle of the different tasks of the field. Her daily life becomes difficult and she must ask for help with some tasks, but in spite of everything she will maintain her independence with conviction and will start with one last challenge.

programme.title: Reign of Terror
programme.desc: The French Revolution, 1794. The Marquis de Lafayette asks Charles D'Aubigny to infiltrate the Jacobin Party to overthrow Maximilian Robespierre, who, after gaining supreme power and establishing a reign of terror ruled by death, now intends to become the dictator of France.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Izdaja
programme.desc: Farmaceutkinja Debi Ešli, koja se skoro udala, pronađena je mrtva u gepeku svog automobila, a policija sumnja na umešanost bande. Uskoro jedno svedočenje otkriva mračne tajne.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Pratite živote 12 ljudi od kojih svi imaju preko 270 kg. Tokom svojih višegodišnjih putovanja pokušali su zajedno da izgube nekoliko hiljada kilograma.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Pratimo živote ljudi težih od 300 kg. Kroz svoja jednogodišnja putovanja, oni pokušavaju da izgube hiljade kilograma kolektivno, kako bi preživeli.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Pratimo živote ljudi od kojih svaki teži preko 270 kg. Kroz svoja jednogodišnja putovanja, oni pokušavaju da izgube mnogo kilograma kako bi preživeli.

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova
programme.desc: Karla želi da pokaže više kože nego što bi to mama želela, a 52-godišnja Dina je spremna da isproba haljinu. Ona kaže da haljina pristaje samo ako je uska.

programme.title: Sve žene mog muža
programme.desc: Nakon što su ljutite komšije oterale Meri iz Flagstafa, Kodi se pita je li preseljenje bila greška. Kuće u Vegasu se ne prodaju, a treba platiti zakup.

programme.title: Devedeset dana: Samački život
programme.desc: Omiljeni učesnici iz udobnosti svog doma bez zadrške iznose sočne utiske o drami iz prethodne epizode.

programme.title: Veridba od 90 dana: Život u braku

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Killer armies collaborate to take down larger prey. On land, a zebra's kick can kill, but in the water it's easy meat for a congregation of crocodiles. Wild dogs may not seem like fearsome predators, but a pack kills fast, brutally and often.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Savuti is big cat country, where only the most resourceful predators thrive. This film follows three characters through winter as small game vanishes and buffalo arrive. The Marsh Pride faces tough terrain and rival lions, while Saba, the matriarch, struggles after a hyena attack. A lone female leopard adapts her hunting strategy to survive in a lion-dominated landscape. Through nighttime hunts and clever use of terrain, these predators battle Savuti's harsh conditions and each other.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: In the forest's dark underworld, there's a lot more happening than meets the eye. Under every rock, behind every tree, death could be lurking.Africa's largest cobra is beat to the chase by the Giant bullfrog. Big Brown Bats use sonar to take out Wax moths at high speed. And the world's 2nd fastest cat leaps 10 feet into the air after its aerial prey.When death comes to the underworld, it takes the express!

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Another rare species and close relative of manatees is the dugong. Dugongs cling to survival in a few isolated corners of the globe. In marine sanctuaries in Abu Dhabi, the bizarre animals have been notoriously difficult to find, let alone photograph. Manatees and Dugongs features exclusive HD imagery of the mammals in the wild and examines efforts of scientists to protect the two species. The program also includes thrilling captures and field exams of manatees in Florida.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: This angry spirit doesn't like being dead and still considers himself the sole owner of lovely Oaklands Mansion.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The team learns to expect the unexpected, as objects move on their own and unexplained sounds plague the investigators.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we explore Las Vegas' lesser known past. We visit the National Atomic Testing museum to learn about how the desert outside of Vegas was used for testing America's secret nuclear weapons. We also visit the Mormon Fort, the first permanent non-native settlement in the area, as well as the Neon Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: It's island living in the Keys on this episode of TTH. We learn about the islands treasure hunting history at the Mel Fisher Museum. Then we'll explore Fort Jefferson, an isolated fort in the Gulf of Mexico that defended the islands. American literature enthusiasts will enjoy a look at Ernest Hemingway's Key West home, where some of his most famous works were penned.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling monster Chinook Salmon with Big Jim Henschke outside Port Hardy, BC!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Ranthambore National Park is part of Project Tiger, a unique wildlife conservation program set up to insure the preservation of the magnificent Tiger. In Ranthambore we encounter the tiger along with Sambar and Blue Bull, Wild Boar and Langur Monkey. We also explore the historic side of Ranthambore which is dotted with ruins of the fort that protected the region for hundreds of years. We end the episode with a tour of a very different national park. Board a rickshaw and join your guide as he explores Keoladeo National Park, known for its abundant bird life.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: India can match Africa mega-animal for mega-animal. The three biggest—elephant, buffalo and rhino are found in large numbers in only one national park in India—Kazaringa. Join Bill as he attempts to check each of these highly endangered and dangerous herbivores off his bucket list.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: To this day sisal, a rope making fiber plant, is a mainstay of the economy. Journeys tours the capital city of Tanzania and its diverse religious institutions before heading into sisal country. We'll learn about the German influences and the seldom heard story of Livingstone's final trip across Africa.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: From the streets of Soweto to the colonial Union Building, the metro area of Joburg is a mix of architecture, people and traditions. Johannesburg is more than just a big city—it's also home to one of the world's best safari parks.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A team of surfers and kayakers have gathered together in Costa Rica to search out world-class surf breaks, remote rivers and virgin waterfalls.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Alaska is known for it's Alaskan Pipeline and the best heli-skiing this episode takes us deep into mountain lines as we try to out run avalanches.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.title: Everyday Elements

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how a pharmacist and an accountant created the most famous drink in the world, coca cola! And, learn the "Bear" truth behind how a U.S. president helped create everyone's favorite stuffed toy, The Teddy Bear! Then, how did a piece of wire accidentally "Slink" its way to become a fantastic fun toy for children? Plus, how a the wiffle ball was invented.

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.
